entry.title: New: Resolution 391 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS THE RULES OF PROCEDURE AND ORGANIZATION OF THE COUNCIL OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I BY AMENDING RULE NO. 25, INVOCATION

Seeks to incorporate ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi and Hawaiian cultural practices into County Council meetings by adding kahu and kumu to the list of persons eligible to perform the invocation.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 391-24 & GOEAC-103 - 01/24/24
